page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, resulting in a configuration of 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile of the ecs.c2.medium presents a clear tradeoff between compute capacity and memory allocation. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to gigabytes of RAM, this instance is structured for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution resources but have minimal memory footprints. The lack of local storage requires reliance on external block storage solutions. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance class is optimized for raw CPU-bound tasks where paying for additional memory or local storage overhead is unnecessary.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and low memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.c2.medium is designed for compute-heavy workloads. Suitable applications include batch processing, CPU-bound computational tasks, and distributed analytics nodes that do not require large in-memory datasets. It is also applicable for serving as a dedicated worker node in CI/CD pipelines or running lightweight web servers where memory consumption is predictable and low.
